maria: Following the postmortem, small list of alert-tuning follow-ups. Need owners + clear timelines. Short replies only.
lee: I'll own dedupe and fingerprinting. Plan: add `fingerprint: service|code|region` and a default suppression 600s. Will open PR + include parser tests.
ojas: I'll take thresholds and paging policy. Proposal: increase ratelimit for redis-timeout from 5->12 errs/min (5m window) and add per-fingerprint paging cooldown 10m. Will update runbook.
maria: Add rollback toggle flag `feature.alert_tuning_v2=false` and a one-click rollback in runbook. Also need dashboards to prove reduction in pages.
deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #512 by lee: https://git.company/infra/alerting/pulls/512 - "router: fingerprint dedupe + suppression"
lee: PR includes config snippet: ```yaml
- name: redis-timeout
  fingerprint: "service|error_code|region"
  suppression_s: 600
```
ojas: I'll prepare a canary rollout: 10% routes for 48h, monitor pages_sent, unique_fingerprints, alert_rate. Rollback condition: pages_sent increases >10% or MTTR +15%.
maria: Deadlines: Lee merge PR by 2026-05-05 12:00 UTC; Ojas thresholds+runbook+canary by 2026-05-06 EOD; Maria will add items in tracker and verify dashboards by 2026-05-04 EOD.
lee: Ack. I'll also add smoke job that posts hourly counts to #eng-oncall for 72h post-deploy.
ojas: Ack. I'll tag dashboards `ops/alert-tune/may2026` and schedule 30d review.
maria: Action items summary (added to tracker): 1) Lee - fingerprint dedupe PR, tests, smoke job, merge - due 2026-05-05 12:00 UTC. 2) Ojas - thresholds, paging policy, runbook, canary - due 2026-05-06 EOD. 3) Maria - tracker + validate dashboards - due 2026-05-04 EOD. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
